_note: Translate every string value. Keep keys, IDs, model names, numbers, units and markdown. Do not translate prompt text (it is not in this file).

boudoir.title: Boudoir & Lingerie
boudoir.intro: The most reliable NSFW image-to-video category: one subject, soft light, small motions. Start here if you are new.

fineart.title: Artistic Nude & Fine Art
fineart.intro: Nudity treated as figure study: sculpted light, silhouettes, classical poses. Works well on every Spicy model because motion is minimal.

couples.title: Couples & Romance
couples.intro: Two consenting adults. Two-person clips are harder: keep the action slow, give each person a distinct outfit or colour, and prefer side angles.

dance.title: Solo Performance & Dance
dance.intro: Rhythm and body movement. Use models with strong motion (Seedance, MiniMax H3) and keep clips short.

water.title: Bath, Shower & Water
water.intro: Water, steam and wet skin sell realism. Static or slow cameras keep the water physics believable.

fantasy.title: Fantasy, Sci-Fi & Cosplay
fantasy.intro: Adult fantasy characters. Costumes and effects do the heavy lifting; describe one magical or tech element at a time.

anime.title: Anime & Hentai Style
anime.intro: Every character here is an explicitly adult design. Generate the first frame with Qwen Image 2.1 LoRA, then animate with Vidu Q3 Spicy or Wan 2.2 Spicy.

commercial.title: Commercial & Brand-Safe Sensual
commercial.intro: Lingerie, swimwear and fragrance-ad aesthetics for adult brands and creator promos. Suggestive, not explicit, so they also suit platforms with stricter rules.

motion.title: Reusable Motion & Camera Templates
motion.intro: Drop-in prompts that only describe motion and camera. Pair them with any first frame; they work because image-to-video models already see the subject.

lora.title: LoRA Style Prompts (Wan 2.2 Spicy LoRA)
lora.intro: Prompts written to pair with a style LoRA. Put the LoRA's trigger word first, then keep the prompt focused on motion.

images.intro: Image-to-video is only as good as its first frame. These prompts generate clean, well-lit first frames of adult subjects that animate well: one subject (or a clearly separated couple), simple background, hands relaxed, face unobstructed or deliberately hidden. Photoreal first frames use Qwen Image 2.1, the recommended uncensored image model on SpicyAPI; anime frames use Qwen Image 2.1 LoRA.
